title: Formal Conjectures (Open Research): Erdős, Green & Combinatorial Conjectures
description: Twenty-five genuinely open conjectures in combinatorics, graph theory, additive combinatorics, and discrete geometry (two-sided prove-or-refute targets via POST .../submit or POST .../refute) extracted verbatim from google-deepmind/formal-conjectures@5bd8bfb9 (Apache-2.0), including 7 FC100OpenSet2 benchmarks (Erdős–Ulam #212, Zarankiewicz K_{r,r} #714, even-cycle Turán #572, Reed's ω-Δ-χ conjecture, Beck–Fiala, 1/3–2/3 poset conjecture, Babai–Seress Cayley diameter) plus Ringel, Kotzig, Gyárfás–Sumner, Barker sequences, Weighing Matrices, Manickam–Miklós–Singhi, Hindman's sumset question (#1199), and 8 Ben Green open problems.
